name: state
meaning: 0 idle, 1 shaking (hit by a cannonball), 2 camera follows the swarm, 3 camera follows Sam, 4 releasing the bees one by one. Written only by Hive_SetState (0x4ca305, the sole write in the class range).

name: beeIndex
meaning: Cursor into bees[] for both broadcast loops. In state 4 it is ALSO passed as msg 0x3980's argument, which Bees stores as its alert level, so bees[i] gets alert i - and with four Bees the fourth gets alert 3, which Bees.csv maps to a 0 ms chase and the msg 0x4a taunt path.

name: beeCount
meaning: Result of Scenaric_FindByClass(107 Bees, bees, 4): how many Bees swarms exist in the level. Loop bound for both bee broadcasts (compared unsigned).

name: swarmPresent
meaning: 1 while a Bees swarm is circling this hive (set by msg 0x3e03). Cleared at Init, when a non-mother hive hands the swarm on, and when the mother has finished releasing every bee.

name: isMother
meaning: PROPERTY_HIVE_MOTHER (prop 4). A non-mother hive that is hit broadcasts msg 0x3981 to move the swarm; the mother instead enters state 4 and stings. Lvl-12 (in-game Level 10): res 120 MOTHER=1, res 121/122 MOTHER=0.

name: samInHoney
meaning: Latched to 1 by msg 0x67 (HoneyPot sends it with arg = Sam while Sam stands in the spill) when the argument's classId is 1 and the hive is not already in state 3; it also copies samWatchTime into the timer. Chooses state 3 over state 2. Cleared by Init and Reset only.

name: trackSwarm
meaning: Set to 1 by msg 0x3e04 (the Bees report the swarm has relocated to this hive); makes state 1 aim the scripted camera at the swarm every frame. Cleared by SetState(1).

name: uiFrozen
meaning: Result of sending the Wolf SCN_MSG_UI_FREEZE 0xe when a cannonball hits. SetState(0) uses it to gate the 0xf unfreeze and stores (result == 0) back into it; an incoming msg 0xe clears it. Also cleared by Reset.

name: bees
meaning: The level's Bees objects (class 107), filled by Scenaric_FindByClass with max 4 - exactly the 0x98..0xa7 span. Receive msg 0x3981 ('come to me') from a non-mother hive and msg 0x3980 with an escalating alert in state 4.

name: swarm
meaning: The Bees object that announced itself with msg 0x3e03; its position is what states 1 and 2 point the scripted camera at. Zeroed by Init.

name: sam
meaning: The level's Sam from Scenaric_FindByClass(1, &sam, 1). State 3 aims the camera at him. The return count is discarded and state 3 dereferences it with no NULL check, so a Hive in a level without Sam faults once msg 0x67 arrives.

name: camera
meaning: PROPERTY_HIVE_CAMERA (prop 0) via Scn_GetPropCamera: the camera setup record {u16 focal; s16 rot[3]; Vec3s eye} used for the whole bee sequence. Hive_AimCameraAt reads its focal at +0 and its position at +8 and overrides the record's own pitch and yaw with a look-at.

name: samWatchTime
meaning: PROPERTY_HIVE_TIME (prop 8), in ms: how long the camera stays on Sam after the swarm is released. Lvl-12: 5000 on the mother hive, 10000 on the other two.

name: samWatchTimer
meaning: Millisecond countdown of state 3, loaded from samWatchTime when msg 0x67 first reports Sam in the honey; decremented by g_dtMs, and at <= 0 the hive returns to state 0.

name: beeReleaseTimer
meaning: Millisecond countdown between bee releases in state 4: reloaded with 0x96 = 150 after each msg 0x3980, zeroed by SetState(4).
